title: Photographs of Jelly at the station and family pictures
summary: How Jelly dressed on arrival in Chicago and her family photographs.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: This is where he reminds me of Jerry Veal sometimes. Jerry Veal seems a very pretty number. Oh, yeah. I'm one of these things. I started to ask how he would dress in Chicago.
You mentioned that the diamond in his tooth and all. Well, listen here. That's why I have a final picture of him. He's got a light gray suit on, and it looks so much like him.

When he came down to the station, it was warm. And he had a suit on, but he took the coat off and he had a beautiful shirt with a lovely tie. But he had it open too because it was so hot. Mm-hm. coming down the steps and he's a sister in New York. She's on her father's arm going in church. I just want to get to show you the part here where I'm sitting in church and you don't have to ask anybody who's sitting there, you can look at this long nose. Look here. Look, that's his father, my son's father sitting behind me. And I mean, he sees his father every day where he doesn't see me every day.
Your brother had that same long nose, exactly.

I see these girls here. This child here looks just like a white child. And this man here, where is he? The second man from here. I don't know his name is... And her father, her father was a white man. A doctor, Delahoussay. You know you're Delahoussay. I'm familiar with that name. And he was where they're eating at my dining room table. I had breakfast for them at my house and had dinner. See how little I used to be? And I wasn't smiling on this picture. The man took another one. He said, everybody's smiling at you. I said, but I'm happy, I'm happy. Take me smiling.
But all of your family then was quite late, I guess. Everybody in the family.
My son is the only Brownskin baby that was ever born in the family.
